visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black crop top and blue jeans, walks along a sidewalk. She is engrossed in a phone conversation, her expression one of slight stress. In the background, a construction site is hidden behind large architectural billboards showing park scenes. (2) As she continues talking, a male's hand enters from the left, extending a small pink and white handheld fan. She instinctively reaches out with her free hand, grasping the fan while still holding the phone to her ear and speaking. (3) The interaction escalates when the hand reappears, this time offering a bulky black motorcycle helmet. She awkwardly tucks the helmet under her arm, her speech becoming more fragmented as she tries to balance the objects while remaining on the call. (4) The camera shifts focus downward to a single beige slipper lying on the pavement. A hand picks it up, and the woman is then seen holding the slipper alongside the fan and helmet, her look increasingly bewildered as she stutters into the phone.

An upbeat, acoustic guitar-driven BGM plays consistently in the background. The audio quality is clear, suggesting a field recording with minimal ambient interference. The acoustic guitar continues to provide a light, rhythmic structure throughout the interaction. (3) The female voice continues her phone dialogue, the stuttering intensifying as she reacts to the items being handed to her. The BGM remains steady, and the overall mix maintains a high signal-to-noise ratio, with clear vocal articulation despite the deliberate linguistic tripping.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous social media short featuring a woman stuttering through an awkward phone call while being jokingly overwhelmed with items to hold by an off-screen companion.
